▌ ✦ The gate has four checks (Law 3):                                        ▕▄▖
▌                                                                            ▕ ▌
▌   1. Right slime authored                                                  ▕ ▌
▌   2. Traits hold                                                           ▕ ▌
▌                                                                            ▕ ▌
▌   ▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄ ▕ ▌
▌    func Gate(w *World) Verdict {                                           ▕ ▌
▌        return w.Check(4)                                                   ▕ ▌
▌    }                                                                       ▕ ▌
